summary: Comprehensive architectural plan to transform KÜLV into an authoritative 2D Nordic garden planning system. Safely removes the legacy 3D canvas and Three.js dependencies, redesigns the home page as a calm field-notebook dashboard with an interactive 2D garden preview and botanical illustration zero-states, enhances the 2D yard planner with a desktop slide-out inspector and mobile sheet, refines Plants/Calendar/Journal/Weather/Settings views, and builds a tokenized accessible component library verified by axe and vitest suites.
